title: Termite Origin
description: A Datapack for the Origins mod that allows you to be a termite
body:
# REQUIRES [APOLI](https://github.com/apace100/apoli/releases/tag/2.12.0-alpha.6%2Bmc.1.20.4)!

### Why Termites?
I loooove termites, and now you can experience the joys and wonders of being one of these funny fellas. You get to eat wood and make mud, you also don't get to see! (because you're blind!)

## Nasutitermes
(+) Climbing  
(+) Make mud from dirt  
(+) Spray poison  
(+) Eat wood and leaves  
(+) No fall damage  
(≈) One block tall  
(**—**) Permanently blind (I underestimated how impactful this would be)  
(-) Can't eat normal food

## Macrotermes
Not an origin yet, I'm working on it.
